name: Napa and Sonoma
intro: Napa Valley and Sonoma County, California's wine country north of San Francisco: Yountville, Rutherford, St. Helena and Calistoga in Napa, and Healdsburg, Geyserville and the town of Sonoma. Their stars come from the MICHELIN Guide California. Prices are in US dollars, per person before tax and tip (or the service charge some restaurants add), checked October 2026.
